detailed_descriptions.en: FIGHT AS A SPARTAN WARRIOR Forge your own odyssey in a world on the brink of chaos and become a legendary Spartan hero, fighting mythical creatures along the way. Charge into epic clashes between Sparta and Athens, with battles pitting 150v150 soldiers against each other. TRAVEL TO ANCIENT GREECE Make your way through wild landscapes, vibrant cities, and iconic historical sites. Sail across shimmering seas, climb towering mountains, and discover the heart of a civilization. CHOOSE YOUR PATH Your choices shape the world around you. Play in a living world that constantly reacts to your every decision: forge alliances, spark conflicts, and determine the fate of characters. Customize your gear, ship, and special abilities to become a legend.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
FIGHT AS A SPARTAN WARRIOR

Forge your own odyssey in a world on the brink of chaos and become a legendary Spartan hero, fighting mythical creatures along the way. Charge into epic clashes between Sparta and Athens, with battles pitting 150v150 soldiers against each other.

TRAVEL TO ANCIENT GREECE

Make your way through wild landscapes, vibrant cities, and iconic historical sites. Sail across shimmering seas, climb towering mountains, and discover the heart of a civilization.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH

Your choices shape the world around you. Play in a living world that constantly reacts to your every decision: forge alliances, spark conflicts, and determine the fate of characters. Customize your gear, ship, and special abilities to become a legend.
